text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi Foreign Minister Mohammed Saeed al-Sahaf tells the United Arab Emirates' newspaper al-Itihad his country is ready to solve issue of missing Kuwaitis.
- Unloading of the first rice shipment under the oil-for- food deal concluded.
- Turkish State Minister Ahmet Cemil Tunc says Turkish losses since the imposition of U.N. sanctions on Iraq have reached $60 billion.
- Head of Kurdish Legislative Council condemns Turkish interference in northern Iraq.
- Saudi Arabia warns pilgrims against politics during haj.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and THAWRA)
- Sahaf meets with his Qatari counterpart in Cairo.
